newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo started as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo started as neutral.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it initiated coverage of Apollo Group Inc with a neutral rating.
--"We do not think the company's growth rate -- 30 to 35 percent at best -- justifies the (current) multiple of 58 times August 1997 earnings," Rodman said in a report.
--Rodman estimates EPS of $0.40 for FY96 and $0.55 for FY97. It said Apollo is unlikely to make significantly accretive acquisitions.
--Apollo provides higher education programs for working adults.
